Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the department of ecology to adopt rules regulating certain rainwater collection facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to rainwater collection facilities; and adding anew section to chapter 90.03 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.03 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In order to qualify for the exemptions to rainwater collectionfacilities, the owner of a rain barrel, cistern, or other similar waterstorage facility that has a storage capacity of greater than threehundred gallons must intend to put the stored water to beneficial useon the property where the rainwater was collected and manage the waterstored in the facility in compliance with rules developed by thedepartment under this section. (2) The department shall adopt rules to specify conditions underwhich rainwater collection facilities may be constructed and operatedin order to protect existing water rights and water quality and toprevent the reduction of stream flows to a level detrimental toinstream values. At a minimum, the rules must address consideration ofannual rainfall, population density, and discharge impact fromrainwater collection facilities. In developing these rules, the p. 1 HB 1424department shall work with the representatives of a broad group ofinterested parties, individuals with technical expertise, and projecthosts to adopt rules under this section for permitting rainwatercollection facilities. (3) Rainwater collected under this exemption does not result in awater right under RCW 90.03.250 or 90.03.370. (4)(a) Any person owning or using a rain barrel, cistern, or othersimilar water storage facility greater than three hundred gallons thatwas installed before the effective date of this section may continue touse the facility without obtaining a permit under RCW 90.03.250 or90.03.370 until the department adopts a final rule governing the use ofrain barrels, cisterns, or other similar water storage facilities.After the adoption of final rules, all persons using rain barrels,cisterns, or other similar water storage facilities must comply withthe final rules. (b) A permit issued under RCW 90.03.250 or 90.03.370 is notrequired in circumstances where the use of rainwater collection and usesystems is located on an island where groundwater and surface wateravailability is limited due to saltwater intrusion. (5) The department shall report to the appropriate committees ofthe legislature by December 31, 2008, regarding the implementation ofthis section. After June 1, 2009, the department shall proceed withpermanent rule making to establish exemptions by rule for rainwatersystems consistent with this section unless the legislature acts todirect otherwise.
